provenance_note: generated by dot, 2026-10-24, original artwork; optimized duo revision
name: Mucilage Monk
description: An amber adhesive gastropod with a spiralled ivory-resin shell, an antique brass glue-spreader and a curled paper reliquary. Rounded resin sculpt, polished worn brass, translucent glossy adhesive and tactile paper replace the earlier flat style.
surface_pipeline: Original generated tileable PBR image maps, packed into blend and embedded in GLB. Mesh details and bevels exported. No unlit shader.
cosmetic_fx: A restrained open glue arc and nine hovering amber adhesive drops above the spreader. Toggle FX_ROOT to hide all optional effect geometry. Static cosmetic meshes only, no scripted glue attack or simulation.
recolor_contract: Semantic materials expose linear baseColorFactor over grayscale maps for full runtime recolor; any authored multicolor exceptions are noted per palette slot. Blender uses equivalent texture multiplied by semantic_tint.
runtime: Rigid node posing only; optional FX are static toggleable visual meshes, not scripted abilities. No skinning/animations.
coordinate_system: glTF: metres, +Y up, -Z forward; source Blender +Z up, +Y forward; right +X.
provenance_detail: Original Blender meshes and original generated PBR image maps, created for this request by dot with Astra 6 max collaborators. No downloaded models, scanned assets or external textures.
reexport_note: Re-exported saved editable scene without regenerating geometry. Render must be refreshed separately after visible edits.
optimization: Selective body/shell/detail reduction; UV and PBR maps retained; same-rigid-parent/same-material meshes joined to reduce draw calls. Animation controls unchanged.
lod_policy: LOD0 near hero, LOD1 distant/small-on-screen. Suggested initial switch below 150px projected character height; tune in the game. Effects only LOD0 and optional. No measured FPS guarantee.
preview_source: render.png rendered from actual imported model_fx.glb, not just the authoring geometry
